sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Stacks to 1,000,000
- Only 1,000,000 can be brought into a raid
- Only 1,500,000 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time
- Spawns in stacks of 5,500-13,500
- Can be purchased in the PvE mode through the Expansion Hub
